text:
Amy K: Starting phased rollout for service-inference v2.1.0 -> ramping to 25% over next 20m. Change window: now -> +30m. Pinning model:v2.1.0. @Deploy Bot will shift traffic. Rollback criteria: error-rate > 1.5% or p95 latency +100ms. I'll monitor.

Deploy Bot: initiating traffic shift: 0% -> 10% (v2.1.0)

Ben: ack. watching tracing + kvcache metrics.

Luca: seeing small p95 bump in eu-west (80ms -> 110ms). still within threshold? ops?

Ops Oncall: checked: eu-west spike aligns with GC thrash on dedicated-pool-3. Not global. Recommend hold at 10% for 10m and run an additional warmup to refill KV cache.

Amy K: hold then. @Deploy Bot pause ramp.

Deploy Bot: ramp paused by user request (Amy K). Current state: 10% v2.1.0.

Zoe: running targeted canary test suite now — heavy long-seq prompts. I'll post outputs.

Ben: running quick A/B for sampling variance and tokenization diffs.

Zoe: eval: 3% increased latency on requests >=1k tokens, and a rare tokenization mismatch in ~0.05% of samples. sending samples in thread.

Amy K: samples show minor formatting drift. Not acceptable to push to 25% yet. Options: rollback to v2.0.9 fallback, or ship patch v2.1.1 (runtime tweak). Thoughts?

Luca: feasible hotfix: flip kv-prefetch flag and tweak compilation kernel selection. Can be staged as v2.1.1 within ~90m.

Ben: fallback path is faster: Deploy Bot can route affected region back to v2.0.9 immediately, then we iterate on patch in parallel.

Amy K: decision: perform partial rollback in eu-west and keep global canary at 10% elsewhere. Global ramp paused until patch validated. Execute region pin to v2.0.9.

Deploy Bot: executing partial rollback: eu-west -> routing to v2.0.9 (region pin)

Deploy Bot: completed partial rollback: eu-west now 100% v2.0.9, v2.1.0 removed from that region. Global canary remains 10% (non-eu-west).

Ops Oncall: monitoring. error-rate and p95 returning to baseline in eu-west. GC mitigations queued.

Zoe: rerunning long-seq evals against eu-west post-rollback, results normalizing. will run extended tests over next 30m.

Ben: metrics: eu-west p95 back to ~75ms, error-rate at baseline. No new regressions observed.

Amy K: good. Plan: keep canary at 10% for 1h, patch in staging, then reconvene for go/no-go. I'll update release notes and the change window in the ticket. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Deploy Bot: rollout state: paused. Automated ramp disabled until manual resume.

Ops Oncall: tagging follow-ups: #infrastructure for GC root cause, #runtime for kv-prefetch flag test, and schedule a postmortem if needed.

Amy K: noted. I'll post a short summary to all-hands and update the release ticket. If anyone sees new anomalies ping me directly.

Ben: thanks — standing by.
